text: Hallelujah! I How good to sing praise to our God;how pleasant to give fitting praise. [AA]
The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem,and gathers the dispersed of Israel, [AB]
Healing the brokenhearted,and binding up their wounds. [AC]
He numbers the stars,and gives to all of them their names. [AD]
Great is our Lord, vast in power,with wisdom beyond measure. [AE]
The Lord gives aid to the poor,but casts the wicked to the ground. [AF]
II Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving;with the lyre make music to our God, [AG]
t[1]Who covers the heavens with clouds,provides rain for the earth,makes grass sprout on the mountains, [AH]
Who gives animals their foodand young ravens what they cry for. [AI]
t[2]He takes no delight in the strength of horses,no pleasure in the runner's stride. [AJ]
Rather the Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him,those who put their hope in his mercy.
III Glorify the Lord, Jerusalem;Zion, offer praise to your God,
For he has strengthened the bars of your gates,blessed your children within you. [AK]
He brings peace to your borders,and satisfies you with finest wheat. [AL]
t[3]He sends his command to earth;his word runs swiftly! [AM]
Thus he makes the snow like wool,and spreads the frost like ash; [AN]
He disperses hail like crumbs.Who can withstand his cold?
Yet when again he issues his command, it melts them;he raises his winds and the waters flow.
He proclaims his word to Jacob,his statutes and laws to Israel. [AO]
He has not done this for any other nation;of such laws they know nothing.Hallelujah!
